question: Why did the person's Open button show nothing after the Rust rewrite?
probes: Inspect where Craft Anything expects a built website (dist/, build/, out/ or root index.html)
Compare the original and current root files
resolution: Craft Anything's Open button (project_preview) serves the built website folder itself and needs an index.html in dist/, build/, out/ or straight at the app root. The rewrite left the built screens only in web/dist, so project_preview returned 'There's no built website in this project yet.' Fix: Vite now builds straight into a real project-root dist/ folder (symlinks return 404 in the preview server), and the Rust server, Dockerfile and README serve dist/. Verified: project_preview serves index.html and assets with HTTP 200, a browser snapshot shows the sign-in screen, and cargo build/test plus rebuild_check pass. No app-internal 'Open' button exists, and the framing headers match the original, so neither was the cause.
